prompt: A person, clad in simple work clothes, kneels before a vein of compacted steel protruding from the frozen tundra. The individual wields a pickaxe, poised above the metal with a slow, deliberate swing. A small, furry creature—an animal that offers emotional support—nuzzles briefly against the person’s leg. Several piles of freshly-gathered wood sit nearby, stacked in neat rows. The person’s face is partially obscured by the low angle of the sun, which casts long shadows across the icy ground. A group of figures, observing from a short distance, stand in the background, their posture suggesting careful consideration. The sky is overcast, and a biting wind whips across the landscape.
